params.caption: 🕹️ Xbox Playback shows your whole 25-year Xbox history To mark Xbox's 25th anniversary, Microsoft launched Xbox Playback, a recap of your entire time on Xbox rather than just the past year. It shows the date you started, your first Xbox console, the first game you booted and your Achievements up to today, wrapped in a personalised video and graphics you can share. 🕒 Nov 12, 2026 · 21:34 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GameSpot 👥 @Xbox 👍 React if you checked yours · 💬 What was your first Xbox game? #Xbox #Xbox25 #XboxPlayback #GamingNews
